text: Copilot in Word can draft and iteratively edit documents from a prompt and uploaded notes

text: Copilot in Excel turns raw data into insights by analyzing attached spreadsheets via chat
quote: Turn raw data into clear insights with Copilot in Excel. Detail your task, attach data, and tweak via chat.

text: Copilot in PowerPoint can generate a full presentation from a prompt, outlining flow and visuals

text: Copilot in Outlook generates summaries of emails to help users stay organized
quote: Get ahead of what’s important with clear summaries from Copilot in Outlook that help keep you organized and ready for next steps.

text: Researcher feature finds, synthesizes, and explains information faster

text: Analyst feature helps turn raw numbers into insight through data analysis

text: Users can find files with natural-language requests like 'find my budget spreadsheet'

text: Browse with Copilot lets it perform actions directly in Microsoft Edge, like clicking, typing, and navigating tabs

text: Cowork mode lets Copilot handle bigger multi-step tasks and deliver completed to-dos

text: Users can choose between different leading AI models for different kinds of work

text: Browser actions run step-by-step visibly, letting users watch and take control at any time

text: A copilot can automate repetitive tasks without requiring any coding

text: Users can search for specific file types like 'show me all PDFs' or Word docs on a topic

text: Users can query their calendar with natural language, e.g. 'what's on my calendar for tomorrow'
quote: Check in on your calendar: “What’s on my calendar for tomorrow?” or “When is my next dentist appointment?”

text: Copilot grounds responses in high-ranking web content with hyperlinked citations
quote: This means that Copilot centers its response on high-ranking content from the web and provides hyperlinked citations following generated text responses or in conversation transcripts in voice mode.

text: Copilot Voice mode lets users speak prompts and receive spoken audio responses
quote: If users send prompts in natural language voice within the Copilot Voice mode, they will receive audio responses.

text: Vision feature analyzes images, extracts insights from photos, and supports visual search

text: Copilot can run code to perform complex calculations and generate graphs

text: Copilot can store specific facts users ask it to remember and use them in future responses
quote: Copilot can store specific facts users request it to remember, allowing it to generate more relevant responses and suggestions based on that context.

text: Copilot can proactively suggest research topics based on past queries and stored memory
quote: Copilot may proactively generate personalized research suggestions for users based on things like past research queries and Copilot memory.

text: Copilot pauses to ask for user approval before sensitive actions like purchases, bookings, or sending email
quote: Copilot will ask for your attention and supervision for certain actions, such as buying an item, booking a reservation, sending an email, or deleting a calendar event.
